method: Actual separate-context semantic review of the complete exact source clause, governing context, named production owners, independent test inputs/oracles and applicability decisions; targeted independent executions and final owner source reconciliation as stated below. This review approves the declaration sufficiency, not a precomputed execution outcome.
controllingText: - JSON escapes `\"`, `\\`, `\b`, `\f`, `\n`, `\r`, and `\t`, with every other U+0000 through U+001F emitted as lowercase `\u00xx`;
reason: Read the exact Section34.1 clause and canonical traversal/string/key/number implementations. Independently literal byte/text outputs cover unsigned scalar key order, ordered arrays and named registered set exception, unnormalized strings/line endings, every U+0000–001F escape plus quote/backslash, non-ASCII values and prohibited values. The exact-number clause also names the registered reduced rational string owner. Expected outputs are not produced through another serializer under test.
scopeLimit: The named serialization clause; Unicode normalization tables, all hash preimages and ID allocation remain separate obligations.
actorIndependenceBoundary: The application checks attributed review identity, exact reviewed bytes and current proof relationships; it does not establish the reviewer hidden context. This actual review context is distinct from the named declaration author. The earlier sealed source-only extraction remains a separate unchanged artifact.
reviewerPriorContributionDisclosure: No authorship of this declaration or expected-case test oracle by this reviewing context.
